title: Preserve lifecycle diagnostics for placement-refused test runs
outcome: Test-run history and detail expose the deciding placement refusal and any later monitoring interruption, runtime loss, or unknown-terminal explanation while keeping retained diagnostics bounded.
acceptance: A behavioral test drives a placement-refused observation through a later lifecycle error and verifies the user-visible placement and lifecycle diagnostics through the relevant history or detail surface, with no change to artifact, proof, or verification authority.
